summary: Verified the runtime-string-concatenation fix for 3 previously-scrubbed Vanguard secret-scanner fixtures in tests/test_iter212m11_vanguard_false_positive_fixes.py. (1) All 3 targeted tests pass. (2) Full file runs 40/40 passed, no regression. (3) Independently re-scanned the test file's own source via services.vanguard_scanner.scan_text() and confirmed ZERO aws_access_key/github_token/openai_key findings against the raw file text - meaning a push-protection-style scanner scanning the file itself would NOT see contiguous secret-shaped literals, so the redaction-on-push problem is not recreated.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal, well-scoped, and idiomatic: uses runtime f-string interpolation of two short concatenated halves so the secret shape only assembles in memory, never in file source. Correct approach for evading platform-side push-protection scrubbers.
Suggest adding a brief inline comment (already present per problem statement) referencing WHY concatenation is used, so future maintainers don't 'clean up' by re-joining the literals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vanguard false-positive/regression test file is fully green (40/40). Independent self-scan of the test file yielded zero aws_access_key/github_token/openai_key hits (only unrelated generic_api_key/password_assignment/token_assignment/generic_secret/requests_no_verify hits from OTHER fixture strings, which are intentional assertion inputs and orthogonal to this fix). Next work item per session context is rate-limiter test isolation (separate).
rca of the issue: Root cause was NOT in services/vanguard_scanner.py (regexes intact). Original 3 fixture literals ('sk-...', 'AKIA...', 'ghp_...') matched real secret shapes and were replaced with '***REDACTED_X***' placeholders by a platform-side push-protection scrubber during git push, causing the 3 tests to assert against placeholder strings that no longer matched the scanner regexes. Mitigation: rebuild the fixture strings via runtime string concatenation of two innocuous halves (e.g. 'AKIA' + 'ABCDEFGHIJ1234KL') so no contiguous secret-shaped literal exists in the file's source text/diff. Verified by (a) 3/3 target tests green, (b) 40/40 full-file green, (c) independent scan_text() against the test file's raw source returns zero aws_access_key/github_token/openai_key findings.
